{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=grass| type2=ground| trainername=Paul| pokemonname=Torterra| jtrainername=シンジ| jpokemonname=ドダイトス| tmtrainername=Shinji| tmpokemonname=Dodaitose| image=[[File:Paul Torterra.png|250px]] | caption=Paul's Torterra| location=[[Sinnoh]] | epnum=DP040| numeps1=an unknown number of| firststagename=Turtwig| numeps2=an unknown number of| secondstagename=Grotle| epname=Top-Down Training!| evolution=2| firstevoep=DP002| firstevonametiming=Prior to| firstevoname=Two Degrees of Separation!| secondevoep=DP002| secondevonametiming=Prior to| secondevoname=Two Degrees of Separation!| prevonum=387| evo1num=388| evo2num=389| current=With [[Reggie]] in [[Veilstone City]]| enva1=[[Carter Cathcart|Billy Beach]]| enva3=[[Carter Cathcart|Billy Beach]]| java1=N/A| java2=N/A| java3=[[Unshō Ishizuka]]| }} '''Paul's Torterra''' (Japanese: '''シンジのドダイトス''' ''Shinji's Dodaitose'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by [[Paul]] and his [[first partner Pokémon]] as well. ==History== ===Pre-series=== Torterra, while still a Turtwig, first became partners with Paul when he started out as a [[Pokémon Trainer]]. Whilst both young and inexperienced, Paul and Turtwig experienced [[Reggie]]'s battle against {{an|Brandon}} at the [[Battle Pyramid]], taking Reggie's loss to heart and striving to become better. Traveling through the [[Hoenn]], [[Johto]], and [[Kanto]] regions, Turtwig competed in each of the region's {{pkmn|League Conference}}s and evolved into Torterra at some point during these adventures. ===''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''=== It debuted in ''[[DP040|Top-Down Training!]]'', where it was used in a battle against [[Cynthia's Garchomp]]. Quickly launching a powerful {{m|Giga Drain}} attack to exploit her [[Recharge|temporary immobilization]] following her earlier use of {{m|Giga Impact}}, Torterra was initially able to bring the {{pkmn|category|Mach Pokémon}} to her knees. This was followed up by a tremendous {{m|Frenzy Plant}}; however, Garchomp proved too powerful for Torterra and was able to withstand the attack with her fins before knocking out Torterra with a single {{m|Brick Break}} attack to the head. It was treated to recovery by Nurse Joy and {{an|Cynthia}} commented on how powerful Torterra was. [[File:Cynthia Garchomp vs Paul Torterra.png|220px|thumb|left|Torterra battling Cynthia's Garchomp]] In ''[[DP051|Glory Blaze!]]'', Torterra helped Paul's brutal training of {{TP|Paul|Chimchar}}. It fired {{m|Hyper Beam}} for Chimchar to dodge, followed by a {{m|Leaf Storm}} which trapped and badly injured Chimchar. In ''[[DP052|Smells Like Team Spirit!]]'' it was used in the semi-finals of the [[Hearthome City Tag Battle Competition]]. It was paired off with [[Ash's Staravia]] and was up against [[Brock's Croagunk]] and [[Holly]]'s {{p|Farfetch'd}}. Paul showed total disregard for Ash, ordering Torterra to blast Farfetch'd with Hyper Beam, not caring that Staravia was hit as well. With Farfetch'd out, Croagunk challenged Torterra and managed to damage it with a powerful Brick Break to the head, similar to its battle against Garchomp. Before Croagunk could follow up, Torterra recharged and hit Croagunk with Leaf Storm, winning the round single-handedly. [[File:Ash Grotle Paul Torterra.png|thumb|220px|Torterra and [[Ash's Grotle]]]] In ''[[DP100|Aiding the Enemy!]]'', Torterra saw the battle between [[Ash's Turtwig]] and [[Paul's Honchkrow]]. It also witnessed the Evolution of Turtwig and his loss of speed. Later on, it used Frenzy Plant against Paul's {{p|Weavile}} in a practice battle to improve Torterra's reflexes; however, it remained distracted by Ash's Grotle who was in the Pokémon Center at the time. While Ash's Grotle was training to become faster, Torterra came forwards on its own to show him that a Pokémon could still be powerful by coping with its lack of speed with strong defense. To prove this, it battled [[Ash's Gliscor]] in a practice match. After teaching this, Torterra returned to Paul's camp. Paul, while curious as to where Torterra had gone, did not push the issue. In ''[[DP131|Pedal to the Mettle!]]'', Torterra was Paul's first choice of Pokémon during his and Ash's [[Full Battle]]. Ash substituted {{AP|Buizel}} for {{AP|Gliscor}}, who used {{m|Sand Attack}} and its ability to fly to dodge Giga Drain. However, Paul and Torterra used Frenzy Plant to lull Gliscor into a false sense of security and when Ash continued to attack at close range, Torterra {{m|Crunch}}ed Gliscor's tail and used Giga Drain to sap energy to recover. However, Gliscor used {{m|Fire Fang}} to injure Torterra, and was recalled by Ash. {{AP|Staraptor}} went up against the disadvantaged and tired Torterra, but it became aware that Paul predicted this and Torterra hit with a supereffective {{m|Stone Edge}} before Paul recalled it. In ''[[DP132|Evolving Strategies!]]'', it fought against [[Ash's Infernape|Ash's Chimchar]], where it was shown to control its {{m|Stone Edge}} at will to mow down its faster opponents. It was {{m|Light Screen|protected}} by {{TP|Paul|Electabuzz}} and managed to absorb Chimchar's Flamethrower, forcing Ash to retreat for Gliscor again. However, Paul does not toy with Gliscor this time and it is knocked out with a single Frenzy Plant. Ash deliberated and chose to send out {{AP|Pikachu}}, but Torterra was recalled and not used for the rest of the battle. In ''[[DP188|Battling a Thaw in Relations!]]'', Torterra was at Reggie's house, along with Weavile, {{TP|Paul|Ursaring}}, and {{TP|Paul|Honchkrow}}. It was unhappy to hear that Paul had lost in the quarterfinals of the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]]. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Paul Torterra debut.png|thumb|220px|Torterra in its debut]] [[File:Paul and Torterra.png|thumb|220px|left|Torterra and Paul]] Unlike the majority of [[Paul]]'s Pokémon, who are either brutal like their Trainer or completely indifferent towards Paul's attitude, Torterra is calm and somewhat kindhearted, as it actually went out of its way—against Paul's wishes—to help {{AP|Grotle}} cope with his lack of {{stat|Speed}} upon [[Evolution|evolving]] and taught its pre-evolved form how to use {{stat|Defense}} to make up for the lack of Speed. Nevertheless, Torterra remains completely obedient and loyal toward Paul, and despite its occasional acts of kindness, it follows its Trainer's orders without hesitation. This was seen when Torterra, along with Paul's other Pokémon, were ganging up on {{AP|Chimchar}} as part of the Chimp Pokémon's harsh training, despite Chimchar being visibly exhausted and injured. In spite of this, Torterra did not express pleasure in these brutal methods, unlike its teammates. While it was never directly referred to as Paul's strongest Pokémon, his treatment of it indicates that he holds it in high regard. It was used during Paul's battle against [[Cynthia's Garchomp]] at [[Amity Square]], and even though many of Paul's other Pokémon had already fallen to the [[pseudo-legendary Pokémon]], he continued battling. When Torterra was defeated, Paul forfeited the battle. Torterra also boasts great strength and longevity, shown most prominently in its [[Full Battle]] performance against {{Ash}}, and was praised by {{an|Cynthia}} as being exceptionally well-trained. It was one of the very few Pokémon that Paul showed consistent respect for, and throughout its appearances, it wasn't scolded or reprimanded by its Trainer once. ==Appearance== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{grass color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{grass color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{grass color light}}; {{roundytop|5px}}" | As a {{pcolor|Turtwig|000}} |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Paul Turtwig.png|250px]] |} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|grass|ground|Paul Torterra {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Stone Edge|1=Frenzy Plant 2|2=Hyper Beam}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Stone Edge|1=Frenzy Plant|2=Hyper Beam}}|image2=Paul Torterra {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Giga Drain|1=Leaf Storm|2=Crunch}}.png|caption2=Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Giga Drain|1=Leaf Storm|2=Crunch}}}} {{anmov|grass|Giga Drain|DP040|Top-Down Training!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|grass|Frenzy Plant|DP040|Top-Down Training!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|normal|Hyper Beam|DP051|Glory Blaze!}} {{anmov|grass|Leaf Storm|DP051|Glory Blaze!}} {{anmov|dark|Crunch|DP131|Pedal to the Mettle!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|rock|Stone Edge|DP131|Pedal to the Mettle!|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|ground|yes|c=l}} ==Artwork== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{ground color dark}}; background: #{{grass color}}; font-size: 80%" |- | style="{{roundy|5px}} border: 2px solid #{{grass color dark}}; background: #{{grass color light}}; width:96px; height:96px"| [[File:Paul and Torterra DP.png|x150px]] |- | Official artwork from
''{{color2|000|Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl}}'' |} ==Trivia== * For [[DP085]], [[Professor Oak's Big Pokémon Encyclopedia]] is about Paul's Torterra. He writers this {{wp|senryū}} about it: 「シンジとは　ふるいつきあい　ドダイトス」 ''"{{tt|Shinji|Paul}} and {{tt|Dodaitos|Torterra}} have been friends for a long time."'' * This is the second time one of Ash's rivals have had an evolved form of a first partner Pokémon that Ash owns. The first is {{Gary}} who owned a {{TP|Gary|Blastoise}}. It could also be noted that both Pokémon were the rival's first partner Pokémon, they are both turtle-like Pokémon, they both were seen for the first time in their final form, have never been seen in their mid-evolved forms which are also seen to be owned by a main character and were seen in their first form in flashbacks. ** However, with Gary and Blastoise, it was never actually confirmed until [[EP269|a later episode]] that the {{p|Squirtle}} in the flashback was his. * With the exception of {{m|Crunch}}, all of Torterra's moves have, at some point, had 5 [[PP]] in the {{pkmn|games}}. ==Related articles== *{{animespeciesevo2|Turtwig|Grotle|Torterra}} *[[Ash's Torterra]] {{Paul's Pokémon|grass|ground}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Paul's Pokémon|Torterra]] [[Category:Animation characters' first Pokémon|Torterra, Paul's]] [[de:Pauls Chelterrar]] [[es:Torterra de Paul/Polo]] [[fr:Torterra de Paul]] [[it:Torterra di Paul]] [[ja:シンジのドダイトス]] [[zh:真司的土台龜]]
